findings.label: Break-straddling lab double
findings.detail: Mani's relocated Python Lab double sits at Thu c5-c6, spanning the afternoon break, which the plan's stated lab rule discourages. It is faithful to the source (original Mon c5-c6 span straddles identically), so it changes no period and is not a regression. Non-blocking; note only if a future rule enforces same-side-of-break doubles.
